name: jk_flip_flop
description: Logic was correct.
notes: Logic was correct. Case now lists all four input combinations explicitly.
code:
module jk_flip_flop (
    input  logic clk, rst,
    input  logic j, k,
    output logic q
);
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) q <= 1'b0;
        else begin
            case ({j, k})
                2'b00:   q <= q;     // hold
                2'b01:   q <= 1'b0;  // reset
                2'b10:   q <= 1'b1;  // set
                2'b11:   q <= ~q;    // toggle
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule
